author: Apironecom
raw_text:
Accept payments on popular networks: BTC, LTC, ETH, BNB, and others, as well as USDT and USDC tokens.



We ensure transparent custody: each account is assigned separate, isolated addresses, and all transactions take place on the blockchain. Unlike traditional acquiring, you can withdraw funds instantly, set up recurring payments, and run mass payouts.



Apirone is open and reliable: the service has been operating without downtime since 2017, with seamless updates along the way. Everything you need for stable business operations.



Apirone integration is available through multiple products and tools:



API for fully custom development



SDK for faster implementation



Plugins for popular platforms



Widgets for quick, no-code payment setup



Apirone serves over 20 million addresses and processes around 2,500 transactions daily, providing the industry with reliable infrastructure for digital asset operations worldwide. We are ready to support your payment integration and would be glad to connect with everyone here.
